source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The wrapper creates its XUL child through the findbar getter. Find commands, open, the browser setter and Chat field passthroughs use that getter. By contrast hidden/browser getters and clear/close inspect an existing child without creating one; MessagePane uses those passive methods during view changes. A property access can therefore materialize the child even without a search-command method call. This is the explicit inspected interface, not full findbar parity or proof of zero startup cost.
title: Lazy-findbar state checks and command accesses have different creation effects
